payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the variations of the attention-based approach examined in the context of harassment detection in tweets.

claims.text: The attention-based approach includes variations such as multi-attention and single attention models.
The MultiAttentionRNN model incorporates four attention mechanisms, one for each harassment category.
The models evaluated include LastStateRNN, AvgRNN, AttentionRNN, and MultiAttentionRNN.
The multi-attention method with a projected layer achieved the highest performance in experiments.
